# Furlpay

> The on-chain financial operating system — stablecoin payments, travel booking,
> global local accounts, fractional stock investing, and agentic (AI) payments in
> one client. Settled on Arbitrum. Phishing-resistant (WebAuthn passkeys), 2-of-2
> MPC custody, compliance-aware.

Furlpay is both a consumer app and developer infrastructure. For AI agents, the
most relevant surfaces are the x402 facilitator, the travel booking API, and the
MCP server — an agent can search flights and stays, pay per-request in USDC, and
receive an on-chain receipt.

## Capabilities

- Stablecoin payments (USDC, EURC) — settled on Arbitrum One (0.5% fee), plus Base and Solana
- Travel booking — 2.2M+ hotels and flights across 230+ countries, pay in USDC, 2% cashback
- Global local bank accounts (USD, EUR, GBP, INR)
- Fractional stock investing via Alpaca
- AI agentic payments via x402 protocol (Arbitrum, Base, Solana)
- Chain-abstracted intake via Circle CCTP V2 (Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Solana → Arbitrum)
- Creator Program — up to 10% commission for travel creators, paid weekly in USDC
- Furlpay Payouts — instant USDC payout rails (B2B, for creator programs and marketplaces)
- Solana Actions & Blinks
- Crypto-backed credit lines, rewards & cashback
- MPC + WebAuthn passkey custody (no seed phrases)

## Wallet names (payment handles)

A FurlPay Wallet name is a human-readable payment handle — yourname.furlpay.com —
that an account and its AI agents present when paying over the web. It replaces a
long hexadecimal address with a name a person can read, verify and type.

- Free to reserve; 3–32 characters, letters/digits/hyphens, normalized to lowercase.
- Reserving requires signing in, so every handle is bound to exactly one verified
  account. Anonymous reservation is not possible.
- The reservation grants READ-ONLY permissions (profile, balances, transaction
  history). Reserving a name can never move money; payments require a separate,
  stronger authorization that an AI agent never receives implicitly.
- Settlement is USDC over the open x402 standard, across Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum,
  Solana, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche and Gnosis.
- Reserve at: https://furlpay.com/wallet
- Launch post: https://furlpay.com/blog/furlpay-wallet-names-are-live-claim-your-payment-handle

## Travel booking (agent-bookable)

- Search + book 2.2M+ stays and flights; pay in USDC on Arbitrum, earn 2% cashback
- On-chain booking escrow with oracle release; ERC-721 booking receipts
- Agent flow: discover via MCP → pay via x402 → escrow releases on-chain → receipt mints
- Travel hub: https://furlpay.com/travel

## Creator Program (travel creators)

- Up to 10% commission, paid weekly in USDC — no 60-150 day holds, no bank minimums
- 90-day cookie window; followers earn 2% USDC cashback
- Apply: https://furlpay.com/ambassadors

## Furlpay Payouts (B2B)

- Instant USDC payouts for creator programs, OTAs and marketplaces — global, $0 minimum
- https://furlpay.com/payouts

## Agentic payments (x402)

- x402 facilitator API: https://furlpay.com/api/x402/facilitator
  - GET  /supported  — scheme/network kinds (arbitrum, arbitrum-sepolia, base, solana)
  - POST /verify     — validate a payment payload against requirements
  - POST /settle     — verify + settle on-chain (single-use nonce, replay-safe)
- x402 resource catalog: https://furlpay.com/api/x402/resources (agent-discoverable)
- Payment-rail map: https://furlpay.com/api/rails (all rails: protocol, chains, fees, caps, live status)
- Gasless USDC transfers: https://furlpay.com/api/transfers/gasless (EIP-3009 relay, fees in USDC, gas sponsored)
- Payment fee estimate: https://furlpay.com/api/payments/fees/estimate?amount=150
- Chain status: https://furlpay.com/api/chain/status
- Pay-per-call demo endpoint: https://furlpay.com/api/x402/fx (402 → quote)
- Open-source middleware: https://github.com/FurlPay/furlpay-x402 (@furlpay/x402)
- Docs: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/agentic-x402

## Supported networks

| Network      | Token | Settlement | Role                    |
|--------------|-------|------------|-------------------------|
| Arbitrum One | USDC  | ~250ms     | Primary settlement rail |
| Base         | USDC  | ~2s        | x402 + bridge source    |
| Solana       | USDC  | ~400ms     | x402 + payments         |
| Ethereum     | USDC  | ~12s       | Bridge source (CCTP V2) |
| Polygon      | USDC  | ~2s        | Bridge source (CCTP V2) |
